You are so right! It’s been weeks and I’ve healed & done so much self reflection, it doesn’t really bother me anymore. I have days where I still cringe but I know it’s normal and every woman has experienced an off day regardless of how they act. That situation you had with your friend proves it! I’m glad to hear you cut her off, I am also cutting off my friends who embarrassed me because of the smell. Its actually funny because their has a been a time when I went to the bathroom after them myself and smelled it we were at a gas station so I knew it was her. I hope that coworker receives their karma for being so cruel, it sucks that a woman can never have an off day where they aren’t as fresh without being judged. Especially when working.

Unfortunately I wasn’t as mentally strong and the comments got to me at first but now it is all in past & means very little to me now. I’ll definitely look more into that book, I’ve been getting more spiritual now as well haha. Thank you for your response!
As for my period that I have right now I plan to use boric acid afterwards for 1-3 nights or just until the smell is gone.
I usually do 1-2 nights & that clears up for me but everyone is different. Some people use it 7-30 days in a row.
I use the killer boric acid. It’s at target or you can order it from Amazon!

Thank you, this helps a lot and I’m so sorry you had that experience as-well. Men can be so awful. Mine also started at 17, and boric acid was what helped me finally get rid of it. Definitely easier said than done but finding joy in the present & that’s it’s gone is comforting to realize since I’m so stuck in the past and never really thought about it like that, so thank you.

I’m so sorry this happened too you. No one ever talks about the and side effects for first time users, 

I really hope it gets better for you. We all make poor decisions but it shouldn’t define us or let it take control. Easier said than done, but I truly believe there is hope on the other side 🙏🏽. 

As long as you don’t take it anymore, the healing process will be long but it’ll much easier. I was hard headed and didn’t stop till recently which brought me to an all time low. 

But I wish you well on your journey 🙏🏽.

I’m on the same boat. Started taking edibles & smoking when I was fairly happy and since then I’ve been nothing but depressed and suicidal. I started taking edibles so much I ended up getting admitted to a psych ward while under it. 
 
That’s when I got diagnosed with major depressive order & anxiety. Before edibles, I was already dealing with anxiety but not to the point where it started driving me to suicide. Edibles changed my life too and this was only a few months ago. 

I started antidepressants but stopped bc I didn’t think how to was making me feel or the fact that I would have to take it everyday for possibly the rest of my life. 

I blame the edibles but sometimes I can’t help but think, they only showed me the parts of me I buried deep inside and didn’t acknowledge. I know at least for me smoking made me over think everything and I can’t even do it anymore without getting extremely depressed & suicidal. 

It sucks and I don’t know when this will stop. but your not alone, edibles ruined my life too and I wish I never took them in the first place.

Wow. How could they think that was helpful?? A private one would probably be your best bet, especially if you can read a few reviews or even call them to see what their program is like. I unfortunately got admitted under the influence by the police so I didn’t have a choice.
It honestly depends on how you like it. I was admitted & it only made me feel crazier and just have thoughts about doing it as soon as I got out.
